title: Declare, print, and measure a string
description:
Write a function `string_summary(text)` that returns a tuple `(text, len(text))` - the string itself and its length.

Covers source items 3-5 (declare a `company` variable, print it, print its length with `len()`) as one exercise, since declaring and printing a variable isn't independently gradable without a fixed check.
hints: len(text) returns the number of characters in a string, including spaces.
Return a tuple with text itself as the first item and len(text) as the second.
explanation: len() works the same way on a string as on a list - it counts elements, and a string's elements are its characters.
